content:
sam (Sales): Quick sync — Prospect (Firebreak) wants a POC run next week. Goal: validate 500 qps sustained for 30m with p99 < 250ms and cold-start impact < 60ms. Also they asked about KMS + per-token pricing for burst. Can we confirm run plan + cost estimate?
priya (SE): I can own the run. Proposed cluster: 4x A10g equivalent nodes, batching=auto, kv_cache=on. Ramp: 0 -> 100 -> 250 -> 500 qps over 15m, steady 30m, then 50% drop. We'll collect p50/p90/p95/p99 + CPU/GPU util.
jordan (SRE): Sounds fine. Add network egress measurement and model fallback metric. Note: with 4 nodes we might hit mem pressure at long seq. Can we cap max tokens per request to 1k? Also set concurrency per worker = 4.
ken (Customer): @priya thanks. Also they need KMS encryption at rest + bring-your-own-key. Any perf impact here?
priya (SE): KMS adds negligible RT on inference path (key unwrap at startup). For per-request auth we only do token verification. So no per-token crypto on the hot path. For BYOK/HSM we need a short integration window (1-2 days) — doesn't change throughput.
sam (Sales): Pricing question: customer asked whether burst (6 minutes at 700 qps) is billed at sustained rate or separate. What's our recommendation?
jordan (SRE): Operationally we support burst capacity. Billing-wise, for POC we usually give a fixed credit + track tokens. For quotes: show two options: sustained reserved pricing (30-day commit) vs on-demand with burst uplift ~1.6x for short bursts. I'll send sample numbers after this thread.
priya (SE): Runbook snippet:
```
# stress script (wrk-like)
for phase in 1 2 3; do
  wrk -c $concurrency -t 8 -d ${phase_duration}s -R $target_qps https://redwood.example/v1/generate
done
```
Metrics to capture: request_latency_ms{p50,p90,p95,p99}, gpu_util, kv_cache_hit_rate, error_rate.
sam (Sales): Can we run a quick smoke tomorrow 09:30 PT? Prospect is in PST.
jordan (SRE): I can prep infra. Need a toggle for model fallback policy (llama-70b -> llama-13b) in case we see >2% tail errors.
priya (SE): I'll prepare prompts and the eval set (1000 samples). Also will include a rerank workload to simulate mixed requests.
ken (Customer): Security Qs: they want SOC2 section filled and a short note on data retention for POC — can you confirm retention = 7 days and option to purge on request?
sam (Sales): Yes, default POC retention = 7 days, can purge on request. Add to SOW.
deploy-bot: deploy started: stress-cluster/firebreak-poc v2026-03-23-01
priya (SE): After smoke, I'll post expected run timeline + a conservative cost estimate (tokens + infra hours). :thumbsup:
jordan (SRE): Also will annotate expected hotspots and rollback triggers (p99 > 400ms or error_rate > 1%).
ken (Customer): Great — I'm looping in their infra lead. Thanks everyone.
sam (Sales): Awesome — thanks team. I'll follow up with calendar invite and SOW draft.
